title: How engineers at Nextdoor use Codex to build without limits
summary: How engineers at Nextdoor use Codex with GPT-5.5 to investigate hard-to-reproduce issues, build across platforms, and focus on product outcomes.
body: How engineers at Nextdoor use Codex with GPT-5.5 to investigate hard-to-reproduce issues, build across platforms, and focus on product outcomes.
summaryZh: 本文介绍了Nextdoor的工程团队如何将OpenAI的Codex与GPT-5.5相结合，用于排查难以重现的软件故障、进行跨平台开发以及加速产品功能交付。这一实践展示了新一代AI编程模型在真实企业软件工程工作流中的深入落地与效率提升。
